```plato

// A quadruple of Numbers: the low-level intrinsic 4-tuple; also used for
// homogeneous coordinates (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homogeneous_coordinates)
// and RGBA math.
type Number4
    implements IVector
{
    X: Number;
    Y: Number;
    Z: Number;
    W: Number;
}

// An octuple of Numbers: the low-level intrinsic 8-tuple (SIMD-width lane math).
type Number8
    implements IVector
{
    X0: Number;
    X1: Number;
    X2: Number;
    X3: Number;
    X4: Number;
    X5: Number;
    X6: Number;
    X7: Number;
}
```
